# Resume PDF builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/resume-builder/

Create a clean resume with live preview, printable PDF and editable sections. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter your education, skills and experience, then print or save a clean single-column resume as PDF.

## Limits and checks

Formatting is designed to stay readable. No resume can guarantee parsing by every hiring system or selection by an employer.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
